```{r setup, include=FALSE}
get_results <- function(tbl_name) {
  if (data_source == 'local') {
    rslt <- read_csv(paste0('../results/', tbl_name, '.csv'))
  }
  else {
    rslt <- results_tbl(tbl_name) %>% collect()
  }
rslt
}

prettify_kable <- function(data) {
  rslt <- data %>% kable(digits = 4, format.args = list(big.mark = ','))
  if (knitr::is_html_output()) rslt <- rslt %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = T, border_right = T)
  rslt
}

site_map <- read_csv('../results/site_mapping.csv')

opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

### Multi-Institutional Anomaly Detection
```{r, fig.width=8}

cvg_anom <- trinetx_anom_detect(dat = 
                                  read_csv(file = '../results/COMBINED_cvg_overlap_newanon.csv') %>%
                                  filter(site_anon != 'all') %>%
                                  mutate(prop_pts = prop_pts * 100),
                                var_col = 'prop_pts',
                                grp_vars = c('fact_long'))

cvg_anom_grph <- trinetx_anom_viz(dat = cvg_anom %>% arrange(desc(site_score)),
                                  var_col = 'prop_pts',
                                  grp_col = 'fact_long',
                                  interactive_plot = FALSE)

cvg_anom_grph[[1]] <- cvg_anom_grph[[1]] +
  labs(title = NULL,
       subtitle = NULL,
       y = 'Fact Group',
       x = NULL)

girafe(ggobj = cvg_anom_grph[[1]])
  

cvg_anom_grph[[2]]

```

## Multi-Institutional Anomaly Detection

### Overall
```{r mix_anom_full}

mix_anon_combo <- trinetx_anom_detect(dat = 
                                        read_csv(file = '../results/COMBINED_case_mix_newanon.csv') %>%
                                              filter(cohort == 'full',
                                                     !grepl('U', branch)) %>%
                                        mutate(prop_pts = prop_pts * 100),
                                      var_col = 'prop_pts',
                                      grp_vars = c('branch'))

mix_anon_graph <- trinetx_anom_viz(dat = mix_anon_combo %>% arrange(desc(site_score)) %>%
                                     mutate(branch = factor(branch,
                                                            levels = rev(unique(branch)))),
                                   var_col = 'prop_pts',
                                   grp_col = 'branch',
                                   interactive_plot = FALSE)

mix_anon_graph[[1]] <- mix_anon_graph[[1]] +
  labs(title = NULL,
       subtitle = NULL,
       y = 'ICD10CM Branch',
       x = NULL)

girafe(ggobj = mix_anon_graph[[1]])

mix_anon_graph[[2]]

```

# Couplets

## Single Institution Results

```{r}

couplets_ss_viz(process_output = read_csv(file = '../results/COMBINED_couplets_newanon.csv') %>%
                  filter(site_anon %in% c('site N', 'site L', 'site C', 'site A')))[[1]]

```

## Multi-Institutional Anomaly Detection
```{r, fig.width=8}

cplt_anom <- trinetx_anom_detect(dat = read_csv(file = '../results/COMBINED_couplets_newanon.csv') %>%
                                   filter(cohort == 'cohort_1_denom_prop') %>% 
                                   filter(! str_detect(site_anon,'all|ALL')) %>% 
                                   mutate(prop = ifelse(is.na(prop), 0, prop),
                                          prop = prop * 100),
                                 var_col = 'prop',
                                 grp_vars = c('couplet_name'))

combo <- trinetx_anom_viz(dat = cplt_anom %>% arrange(desc(site_score)),
                 var_col = 'prop',
                 grp_col = 'couplet_name',
                 interactive_plot = FALSE)

combo[[1]] <- combo[[1]] +
  labs(title = NULL,
       subtitle = NULL,
       y = 'Couplet',
       x = NULL)

girafe(ggobj = combo[[1]])

combo[[2]]


```

# Stability Over Time

## Single Institution Results

```{r}

domain_list <- c('respiratory_infection', 'emergency_visits')
site_list <- c('site M', 'site S', 'site B')

final <- list()

for(i in site_list){
  
  temp <- list()
  
  for(k in domain_list){
    
    dm_otpt <- fot_raw_norm_viz(process_output = read_csv('../results/COMBINED_fot_newanon.csv') %>%
                                  filter(check_desc != 'all_visits',
                                         check_desc != 'asthma_inpatient'),
                                site_filter = i,
                                domain_filter = k)
    
    temp[[k]] <- dm_otpt
  }
  
  final[[i]] <- temp
  
}


```

### Respiratory Infection
```{r}

htmltools::tagList(final[[1]][1])
htmltools::tagList(final[[2]][1])
htmltools::tagList(final[[3]][1])

```

### Emergency Visits


## Multi-Institutional Anomaly Detection

```{r, include=FALSE}

fot_combo_rates <- read_csv('../results/COMBINED_fot_rates_newanon.csv')

rate_euclidean <- ms_anom_euclidean(fot_input_tbl = fot_combo_rates %>% 
                                      mutate(time_start = month_end,
                                             time_increment = 'month'),
                                            grp_vars = c('site_anon', 'check_desc'),
                                            var_col = 'incidence_rate')
```
